amsfonts-support-notice.pinned_version: AMSFonts support files 3.01, 2013-01-14; embedded TeX Live 2022 bytes
amsfonts-support-notice.rationale: Each exact generated support file permits unlimited unchanged copying and redistribution and permits modified distributions only under a renamed filename. This file-level notice is narrower and more accurate than the amsfonts package-level OFL catalogue code.

adobe-glyph-list.pinned_version: Adobe Glyph List 2.0; embedded TeX Live 2022 bytes
adobe-glyph-list.rationale: The embedded file contains Adobe's complete Apache-2.0 header and points to the upstream AGL repository.

adobe-pdf-glyph-list.pinned_version: Adobe Glyph List 2.0 PDF subset; embedded TeX Live 2022 bytes
adobe-pdf-glyph-list.rationale: The embedded file identifies itself as compiled from Adobe Glyph List 2.0 and PDF 1.5. It is reviewed with the Apache-2.0 Adobe Glyph List distributed beside it in the same pinned archive.

babel-hyphen-config.rationale: The embedded generated-file header states LPPL 1.3 or later, maintained status, and names Javier Bezos as current maintainer.

graphics-cfg-cc0.pinned_version: graphics-cfg files embedded in TeX Live 2022
graphics-cfg-cc0.rationale: Both exact embedded files begin with the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 URL.

knuth-hyphen-patterns.rationale: The exact file permits unlimited unchanged copying and redistribution and requires modified versions to use a different filename.

latex-fonttext-config.rationale: The embedded generated-file header states LPPL 1.3c or later and identifies the LaTeX base system.

lcdf-typetools-2.95.rationale: The exact resource identifies lcdf-typetools 2.95; that distribution's COPYING file supplies GNU GPL version 2 terms.

tectonic-format-input.rationale: The exact one-line format input is part of Tectonic's maintained bundle input tree and the pinned Tectonic release is MIT licensed.

texlive-generated-maps.rationale: The exact files identify themselves as updmap-generated aggregates. This LicenseRef preserves TeX Live's free-redistribution boundary and requires retention of the underlying component-license inventory; it does not assert a new blanket license over the font programs.

texpdf-generated-metadata.rationale: SHA256SUM is produced by the texpdf curated-bundle builder from the qualified content digest.

texpdf-language-config.pinned_version: texpdf private-RC English-only resource policy schema 1
texpdf-language-config.rationale: This project-owned input deliberately narrows format generation to English hyphenation and its standard aliases.

unicode-14-data.rationale: SpecialCasing.txt identifies Unicode 14.0.0 and links the Unicode terms of use; UnicodeData.txt is the version-matched companion file from the same pinned bundle.
